summary: Opera Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 3, 2026, previewing third-quarter 2026 results and announcing a user milestone. Desktop monthly active users reached 100 million in October, up from 94 million in Q2 2026 and 16% year-over-year. Revenue was $182.8 million, up 20% year-over-year and at the top of the prior $181–183 million guidance; adjusted EBITDA was $43.2 million, a 24% margin, above the $41–43 million range. Full results and a call are scheduled for November 17, 2026. This is an ordinary earnings pre-announcement, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. Watch the formal Q3 release and any Q4 guidance for confirmation of trends.
